sloka: भ्रातरौ उपतस्थुः ते सर्वे च हरि यूथपाअः ।नलम् नीलम् हनूमन्तम् अन्यांश्च हरि यूथपान् ॥१-१७-३३॥
transliteration: bhrātarau upatasthuḥ te sarve ca hari yūthapāaḥ ।nalam nīlam hanūmantam anyāṁśca hari yūthapān ॥1-17-33॥

translations.english: Mighty armed leader Vali endowed with immense prowess protected, with his strong arms all those bears, gopuchhas(cowtailed) and monkeys.
